Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Class RenderResult

java.lang.Object
ke.ric.renderer.api.RenderResult
public final class RenderResult extends Object
Immutable rendered frame, optional attachments, visibility statistics, and measured timings. Constructor inputs are defensively copied, array accessors return copies, and rgbaBuffer() returns a read-only copy.

      public RenderResult(int width, int height, byte[] rgba, float[] depth, float[] normals, int[] material, int[] object, VisibilityStatistics visibility, RenderTimings timings, Runnable checkpoint)
      Creates an immutable result while invoking a cooperative checkpoint during large copies. The checkpoint may throw to stop construction; no partially copied result is published.
